name: Vigilante Outrageous Lyricist
body:
For a vigilante, the drive behind what pushes them forward is different for each and every one of them. For an outrageous lyricist, it’s the acclaim, thriving off the energy and passion of others, drawing their inspiration from the roar of applause that follows a successful performance.

Armor Proficiency: An outrageous lyricist is not proficient with medium armor. They can cast bard spells (see spellcasting below) while wearing light armor without incurring the normal arcane spell failure chance. This alters A vigilante’s armor proficiencies.

Spellcasting: An outrageous lyricist casts arcane spells and cantrips as a bard. They can cast any spell they know without preparing it ahead of time, assuming they have not yet used up their allotment of spells per day for the spell’s level, and they choose their spells known from the bard spell list. An outrageous lyricist’s selection of spells is extremely limited; use Table 3-4: Bard Spells Known in the Pathfinder Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook to determine how many spells the outrageous lyricist knows at each level. An outrageous lyricist needs to practice either singing or playing an instrument for 1 hour in order to replenish their daily spell slots. This ability replaces the 4th, 8th, 10th, 14th, and 16th level vigilante talents.

Vibrant Transformation (Su)

An outrageous lyricist gains the transformation of the magical child archetype.

Powerful Performance (Su)

An outrageous lyricist gains the bardic performance class feature as a bard of their level. They also gain the countersong, distraction, fascinate, and inspire courage bardic performances. This ability replaces vigilante specialization.

Powerful Transformation (Su)

At 3rd level, an outrageous lyricist gains the quick change social talent, and anyone who watches them transform must make a Will saving throw equal to 10 + 1/2 their outrageous lyricist level +their Charisma modifier or be fascinated for 1 minute. An outrageous lyricist must make a Disguise check if anyone witnessed their transformation with a -10 penalty (they can apply their seamless guise circumstance bonus to this check) to avoid exposing their true identity. This ability replaces unshakable.

Lyrical Talents (Ex or Su)

An outrageous lyricist can select from any of the following vigilante talents, in addition to general vigilante talents.

Black Metal Medley (Su)

An outrageous lyricist gains the dirge of doom bardic performance. At 12th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the penalty from the shaken condition bestowed by this talent increases by -1. An outrageous lyricist must be 8th level or higher to select this talent.

Emo Scream (Su)

An outrageous lyricist gains the frightening tune bardic performance, ignoring all immunity to fear. Creatures that would normally be immune to fear gain a +4 circumstance bonus against this effect. At 18th level, those who fail their saving throw against this talent are instead panicked. An outrageous lyricist must be 14th level or higher to select this talent.

Headliner (Su)

Whenever an outrageous lyricist uses their bardic performance to inspire courage, inspire greatness, or inspire heroics, they can spend an additional round of their bardic performance each round to grant themselves a number of temporary hit points equal to 1/2 their outrageous lyricists level. These temporary hit points are refreshed each round, and are lost when the outrageous lyricist stops performing. At 12th level, they can bestow these temporary hit points to all allies affected by their bardic performance. An outrageous lyricist must be 6th level or higher to select this talent. This is a mind-affecting ability, and it relies on audible and visual components.

Lyrical Duel (Ex)

An outrageous lyricist can use Perform (oratory or sing) to demoralize a foe as a swift action. If they do so, at the start of their foe’s round, the foe can choose to make either a Diplomacy (with a -5 penalty) or a Perform (oratory or sing) check; if their result is higher than the outrageous lyricist, they are no longer demoralized and the outrageous lyricist is demoralized for 1 round. If their result is lower or they choose to concede and not make an opposed Diplomacy or Performance check, they are demoralized for an additional round. If the foe attempted a Diplomacy or Perform check but did not exceed the outrageous lyricist’s result, the outrageous lyricist can make another Perform check at the beginning of their round as a free action, extending the duration of the demoralization by 1 round, again giving the foe a chance to make an opposed check or concede. This is a mind-affecting fear effect with audible components.

Masterpiece (Su)

An outrageous lyricist can select a masterpiece for which they qualify.

Moonwalk (Ex)

Whenever an outrageous lyricist is using one of their bardic performances, when they make a 5-foot step, they can instead move 10 ft. At 10th level, they can instead move 15 ft. This movement cannot exceed their normal land speed.

Mosh Pit (Ex)

Whenever an outrageous lyricist is flanking with an ally, they also gain a +2 bonus to damage against the flanked foe. At 6th level and every 6 levels afterwards, this bonus increases by +2.

Power Ballad (Su)

An outrageous lyricist gains the inspire greatness bardic performance. At 16th level, they gain the inspire heroics bardic performance. An outrageous lyricist must be 10th level or higher to select this talent.

Power Slide (Ex)

Whenever an outrageous lyricist makes a successful attack at the end of a charge action, they can spend 1 round of bardic performance to begin a bardic performance as a swift action. At 12th level, they can instead begin a bardic performance as a free action. An outrageous lyricist must be 6th level or higher to select this talent.

Sonic Assault (Su)

Whenever an outrageous lyricist uses their bardic performance to inspire courage or greatness, they can spend an additional round of it each round to convert all weapon damage they deal into sonic damage. At 12th level, they can change the weapon damage of all allies affected by their bardic performance into sonic damage. An outrageous lyricist must be 6th level or higher to select this talent.

Synchronized Routine (Ex)

Whenever an outrageous lyricist uses their bardic performance to inspire courage, inspire heroics, or inspire greatness, they are treated as though they possessed any teamwork feats their allies possessed as long as their allies are benefitting from their bardic performance.

Up to Eleven (Su)

Whenever an outrageous lyricist uses a bardic performance, they treat their bard level as 1 higher for the purpose of its effects. At 6th level and every 4 levels after, their effective bard level increases by an additional 1.

Vicious Feedback (Su)

Whenever an outrageous lyricist uses their bardic performance to inspire courage, inspire heroics, or inspire greatness, all foes within 40 ft of them take a -1 penalty to attack rolls. At 14th level and again at 20th level, this penalty increases by an additional -1. This is a mind-affecting ability, and it relies on audible and visual components. An outrageous lyricist must be 8th level or higher to select this talent.

This ability alters vigilante talents.

Musical Infusion (Su)

At 20th level, all allies benefiting from an outrageous lyricist’s bardic performance are immune to fatigue, exhaustion, negative levels, and fear effects. This ability replaces vengeance strike.
